description: This file implements request validation and evaluation logic for executing commands on a host, including handling security policies and approval processes.

classes.name: ExecHostValidatedRequest
classes.description: Structure representing a validated command request with command details.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates an ExecHostRequest, ensuring it contains a non-empty command and resolving it with an external validator.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the execution context and approval decision to determine if the request is allowed, denied, or requires prompting based on security policies.
